name: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
summary: Merged on 26 January 2020 into a single Union Territory. Former Portuguese enclaves liberated in 1954 (Dadra & Nagar Haveli) and 1961 (Daman & Diu). Renowned for coastal forts and tribal culture.
festivals: Nariyal Poornima, Diu Festival, Folk Dance Festival
monuments: Moti Daman Fort, Nani Daman Fort, Diu Fort (sea-facing Portuguese citadel), Naida Caves Diu, St. Paul's Church
schemes: PM Awas Yojana (Urban & Rural), Integrated Island Development

subtopics.name: Geography
subtopics.summary: Location, borders, physical terrain, and major river systems of Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu.

facts.title: Capital & Geographic Scope
facts.content: The capital is Daman. Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu covers a geographic area of 603 sq km across 3 administrative districts.

facts.title: Major Rivers & Drainage Systems
facts.content: Key river systems flowing through the region include: Daman Ganga, Kolak, Kalai.

facts.title: Geographical Landscape & Highlights
facts.content: Merged on 26 January 2020 into a single Union Territory. Former Portuguese enclaves liberated in 1954 (Dadra & Nagar Haveli) and 1961 (Daman & Diu). Renowned for coastal forts and tribal culture.
